candidates.title: Will Quentin Halys win at least 4.5 more games than Lorenzo Sonego?

candidates.rules_secondary:
The following market refers to the Lorenzo Sonego vs Quentin Halys professional tennis match in the 2026 ATP Stockholm 1/16 Finals. candidates.rules_primary: If Each Yes contract pays $0.05 per reception recorded by Malik Nabers during the Washington vs New York G Pro Football game originally scheduled for Nov 12, 2026.
